selected_candidate.name: intraday_body_next_microgap_reversal_238p
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: A higher score indicates that one-minute open-to-close displacement is more often followed by an opposing next-bar opening discontinuity, consistent with rapid quote or inventory correction after the completed bar rather than propagation into the following print. This may describe a more resilient completed-session microstructure state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_candidate.formula: Within each 120-bar half, form 119 prior-bar bodies b_t=log(close_t/open_t) and 119 following microgaps g_next=log(open_(t+1)/close_t). Pool both halves to 238 aligned transitions and return -Corr(b_t,g_next) using equal-position population Pearson correlation.
selected_candidate.zero_semantics: retain every exact-zero body and exact-zero following gap in the fixed vectors
selected_candidate.variance_semantics: both complete 238-element vectors must have strictly positive population variance
